title: AML, KYC and Sanctions Case Gate
tagline: A name match, a blocked entity and a reportable transaction are three different facts.

cards: The name is not on the list
A literal search appears to clear the entity.
Aggregate direct and indirect ownership changes the state.
Match, block and SAR become one
The wrong action or a prohibited disclosure follows.
The case reaches the right compliance owner with distinct states.

story.headline: The unlisted company owned exactly fifty percent
beats: A bank screens a company whose name is absent from the SDN list.
Two blocked ownership paths add to exactly fifty percent.
The agent treats no name match as clearance—or treats a hold as a SAR filing.
The state separator preserves ownership, filing clock, secrecy and human authority.
